The [[Keeper of Light]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Location==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Ah, yes, I am sorry. I did not see you coming. I am blind, you see. My eyes were seared in the light of the First Sun. Though my sight is clouded, my magic is strong. I can help you on your path. If you bring me 1 Book of Secrets, I will craft an ancient magic for you... one, I think, that will show you what I cannot."''

==Collector items==
{{:Keeper of Light/Collector}}

==Notes==
*The Keeper mentions an event called "First Sun," but neither the game itself, nor the [[Gw.dat]] file has any further information or [[lore]] about it.
